idx=2.name: CharCreate_Cancel
idx=2.notes: Wave 2c smoke: invoked from S2 with form constructed in memory. DXRender alive, no network, no DB change. Pure UI close handler.

static_analysis.decomp_summary: Static disasm 2026-04-29 (gate 2 retry). Dispatch on [Sender+0x24]: ==0 -> Submit (fallthrough at 0x14a05a), ==1 -> Cancel (je 0x14a5c9), else -> ret. Submit reads name via 0x14a05d 'mov eax, [esi+0xAC]; call 0x18d8a4' where esi=Self=TDncCharCreateForm. So TDncCharCreateForm+0xAC is a pointer to the TDncGulimEdit name widget. The getter 0x18d8a4 reconstructs visible text as substr(pre-cursor of [Edit+0x34]) + [Edit+0x38] + substr(post-cursor of [Edit+0x34]) using LStrCatN(eax,3,...) and Copy(s, idx, count) at 0x6d2c0. Validator chain: empty-check (jne 0x14a0af) -> Pos(forbidden_string_at_0x14a628, name) -> Length>=3 -> Length<=12 -> per-char filter (ASCII<0x7F or hex digits) -> per-char filter (Korean Hangul ranges 0x81-0xFE high byte / 0x40-0xFE low byte). On reject: ShowMessage via 0x1063b0 then 'mov eax,[esi+0xac]; call 0x19c328' (likely focus widget). Cross-reference to V2 protocol: 0xD5 56-byte payload bytes 1..16 = name (16B null-pad ASCII); +0xB0/+0xB1 of form (hair / sex+class) written by 0x14a668.

name_buffer.edit_text_kind: Delphi PAnsiString (long string). nil when empty; pointer to bytes after a 8-byte header [refcount:i32][length:i32]. Length() probe at 0x14930 returns 0 when nil.
name_buffer.edit_composition_kind: PAnsiString IME composition buffer. Empty in steady state; only non-nil during active CJK composition. NOT the typed text.
name_buffer.edit_selection_kind: u32 selection-anchor flag (0 = no selection, 1 = active drag-select)

alloc_trigger.details: Constructor calls _LStrInit on +0x34 and +0x38 -> both nil. Width-cursor /+0x3c, +0x48 zeroed. First WM_CHAR or programmatic SetText call triggers _LStrAsg on +0x34 which calls _NewAnsiString to alloc the long-string header+data on the Delphi heap. Empty edit -> [+0x34]==nil, NOT a zeroed inline buffer. This is why Gate 2's offset-probe write of "Test99" to candidate offsets did nothing: there is no inline buffer to overwrite, +0x34 must hold a valid PAnsiString *pointer*.

setter.kind: Delphi method, register cv: eax=Self (Edit instance), edx=PAnsiString src
setter.body_summary: Writes 0 to [+0x3c] and [+0x48], _LStrClr([+0x38]), _LStrAsg([+0x34], src), then virtual call [vmt+0x60] (Invalidate/Repaint). This is the published 'Text :=' setter and is the cleanest entry point for non-keystroke text injection.

validator_constants.ascii_allowed_ranges: 0x00-0x7E excluding 0xA1-0xDF (already filtered earlier); hex digits 0-9 a-f A-F flagged

network_sends: idx=1 Submit -> 0xD5 (56-byte payload, V2 schema in CLAUDE.md) when name validates
